info.bio: Creada por los hermanos McDonald, Jeff y Steven, en su adolescencia, son un grupo de culto con fieles seguidores en todo el planeta. Originariamente, el nombre del grupo era "Red Cross", pero la organización internacional Cruz Roja, mediante sucesivas reclamaciones, mostró su disconformidad por el uso de su nombre, motivo por el cual la banda decidió añadirle otra "D" a "Red", y sustituir la "C" por una "K", para evitar confusiones con dicha organización.

scenes.name: American Graffiti: revival, garage y power-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: American Graffiti (1973) desata el revival de los cincuenta y sesenta, que suenan más auténticos que el rock corporativo de los setenta: rockabilly, surf, folk-rock, psicodelia, bandas sonoras de terror. Los punks descubren el alma malvada del rockabilly: Suicide inventa el psychobilly y los Cramps el «voodoobilly»; Fleshtones, Raybeats, Stray Cats, Von Lmo. El garage revive con Slickee Boys, Pretenders, Wipers, Real Kids; el power-pop con Cheap Trick, Shoes, Cars, Jonathan Richman y Embarrassment. En California, los Blasters y el cow-punk de Rank And File; Tom Petty como teórico del power-pop, Plimsouls, Redd Kross, Go-Go's, Bangles. El blues para la generación punk: George Thorogood, Fabulous Thunderbirds, J. Geils Band, Dixie Dregs.

podcast.title: Covered "1969"
podcast.body: Red Cross is among the artists who have covered The Stooges' song "1969." "Tracks on this album have been covered by the Sex Pistols, Joey Ramone, Sonic Youth, the Sisters of Mercy, Joan Jett, Red Cross, and the Black Keys."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Stooges?

podcast.title: Influence on Major Artists
podcast.body: Red Kross (mentioned as Red Cross) is cited among several California hardcore bands that were very important to the musical education of figures like Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl. "Talk to Eddie Vetter or Dave Grohl, and they'll tell you how some of these bands were really, really important to their musical education."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Red Cross is noted as being very important to the musical education of musicians like Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl. "Talk to Eddie Vetter or Dave Grohl, and they'll tell you how some of these bands were really, really important to their musical education."

podcast.title: Produced by Tommy Ramone
podcast.body: Following his departure from the Ramones, Tommy Ramone continued his work as a producer, creating albums for the band Red Cross. "He also produced albums for the replacements and Red Cross."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
